note: Synthetic cases only. Idempotency scope is (actor, operation, key, input digest). Replay always rechecks current eligibility before any response; sensitive output is never re-served after a restriction.

cases.scenario: Two identical publications contend for the last open slot; one attempt hits a serialization failure and retries.
cases.expectation: Exactly one success commits; the retry rechecks quota and either wins a genuinely free slot or is refused with quota_exceeded. No duplicate request rows, no duplicate events.

cases.scenario: Buyer retries completion with the same idempotency key and identical body after a network timeout.
cases.expectation: Return the existing business result. No duplicate outcome, attribution, or closure event (INV-34, EC-25).

cases.scenario: Same idempotency key reused with a changed outcome source.
cases.expectation: Refuse with idempotency_key_reuse. Never apply the second body under the first key.

cases.scenario: Buyer retries a previously successful contact after the seller blocked the buyer (or account suspended, offer withdrawn, request expired).
cases.expectation: Refuse under current eligibility (INV-28, INV-38). The response contains no phone destination and no cached handoff context.

cases.scenario: Buyer retries a previously successful contact while every guard still holds.
cases.expectation: Return the existing contact record without duplicating unique-contact counts or events; a genuinely later initiation is a repeat event only if eligibility still holds (EC-25).

cases.scenario: Seller submits against request revision R1 after the buyer published material revision R2.
cases.expectation: Reject with current requirements (EC-34). No slot consumed by the rejected attempt; seller may resubmit matching R2 in the existing slot subject to daily allowance.

cases.scenario: Block between buyer and seller is lifted; buyer attempts contact on an offer invalidated during the block.
cases.expectation: Still refused: unblocking removes only the relationship restriction (EC-36, INV-38). A fresh offer in a later eligible cycle is required.

cases.scenario: Offer mutation lands at the same instant the request deadline passes.
cases.expectation: Refused with expired: the business effect did not occur before the exclusive deadline (EC-07). No successful event is recorded.
